_comment: Seed for the jedx-dictionary companion page (SPEC-companionPages-102826 Phase 1), read by seed-companion-page.js. Provenance is from management/zNotesPlansDocs/companionPages-102826/sources/README_PROVENANCE.md. The ORDER of sourceList matters: an earlier draft is uploaded before the later one of the same role and part, so the later one ends current and the earlier one sits in history. workingGroupProposedChanges.xlsx is deliberately absent: the README says it is not a page source. standardKey 'jedx' was read from the standards-neighbourhood answer for jedx:root on GOLD_EVAL_261026_respelled (2026-10-28).
